test_type: REAL WALL CLOCK Chromium browser, original game RAF preserved (not on Galaxy S23+)
important_limitations: 180 real seconds ≠ 180 in-game seconds: automated upgrade choice was checked every 10s, so game spent substantial wall time paused at level-up cards. Only 100.7 seconds of game clock passed. Do not claim to have reproduced the user's severe lag after 3 in-game minutes.
RAF intervals are headless Chromium presentation callback intervals in mobile viewport with SwiftShader; not a phone FPS benchmark, not raw GPU frame timings.
Alive monster counts at sample end (32 and 58) do not validate 180/250 concurrently alive creatures.
Two JS heap endpoint samples do not demonstrate memory leak absence; GC can reduce heap.
No real human steering/survival skill, human game-feel scores, audio or Galaxy S23+ heat observations.
5 minute measurement not executed. The test runner must choose level-up cards more promptly and record pause durations before claiming 3/5 in-game minute performance.
